issues.concern: The English translation 'I'll take it easy and rest today' for '大事を取って今日は休みます。' is misleading. '大事を取る' means to take precautions or play it safe, not simply to 'take it easy'.
issues.suggestion: I'll play it safe and rest today. / I'll take precautions and rest today.

issues.concern: The English translation 'I caught a cold, so I took care and went to bed early.' for '風邪をひいたので、大事を取って早めに寝た。' is misleading. '大事を取る' means to take precautions or play it safe, not simply to 'take care' in this context.
issues.suggestion: I caught a cold, so I played it safe and went to bed early. / I caught a cold, so I took precautions and went to bed early.
